newsitem.title: USA: Danaher sues Exide Electronics - court papers.
newsitem.headline: Danaher sues Exide Electronics - court papers.

text.p: Danaher Corp sued takeover target Exide Electronics Group Inc and its directors on Wednesday, alleging an unspecified "breach of fiduciary duty."
Information papers were filed with the Delaware Chancery Court, but the complaint itself will not be available until it has been served on Exide.
On Wednesday, Danaher launched a hostile $200 million tender offer of $20 a share for the nearly 10 million outstanding Exide shares.
Danaher, which owns 397,000 shares of common stocks and has warrants to buy about 643,000 more for $13.475 each, said its offer was not conditioned on financing.
But in its offer to purchase, Danaher said as a condition of the deal the Exide board must agree not to apply its poison pill defense or Delaware's anti-takeover law against the tender offer.
The poison pill defense would make a takeover prohibitively expensive. Delaware law could delay a takeover for three years unless the target company directors first approve the merger.

A spokesman for Exide Electronics said there would be no comment on the litigation except to repeat the company's statement yesterday which asked shareholders to wait ten days before Exide's response before making any decision.
